analysis: Both units are base-text excerpts of docs/developer/test.md (lines 979+ and 1477+). The supplied text is developer testing documentation: CI runner behavior, coverage reporting, Swift provider test commands, MiMo fixtures, benchmark procedures, and SSD cache tests. No patch hunks or diff were supplied, so I could not identify any specific changed lines. I found no executable code, no permission or authorization change, and no new endpoints. The text touches existing security-relevant test coverage: SSD DBK3 authentication (tamperFailsClosed, T-041), the status-canonical byte vectors shared by the coordinator and provider (TB-009), the PostgreSQL test isolation guard against mutating a configured database, and the statement that CLI/service/fan tests must not use real sudo or production endpoints (TB-010). These do not weaken the documented mitigations, and the text states that production TTL, disk, and receipt policies are unchanged. No threat-model assumption looks invalidated by what was shown. Coverage limit: the actual diff was not visible, so any modified lines outside these excerpts or in other files were not examined. Because the excerpts are documentation only, I do not recommend deeper review for security.
